title: Answer: a living organism is constantly re-created and can host a self

statements.text: A living organism behaves like a giant macromolecule constantly re-created by matter flowing in and out of it, in deep symbiosis with its environment. That dynamism is what lets it represent a live coherent symbol controlled by a unified self.

sources.quote: A living organism behaves like a giant “macromolecule” that is constantly re-created and changed by matter flowing into and out of it.
